name.ja: 30MS オプションパーツセット23(ヴァルキュリアコスチューム)[カラーC]

description.ja: 30MS素体との組み合わせで世界観が広がる！頭部、腕、脚、武装がセットになったオプションパーツがラインアップ！
description.en: The world view expands when combined with the 30MS body! A lineup of optional parts including a head, arms, legs, and weapons!

description.ja: ■脚部などの成形色は「30MS ルルチェ(リリーウエア)[カラーC]」(別売り)と同様の[カラーC]が付属。
description.en: • [Color C] is included for the molding color of the legs, etc., which is the same as "30MS Lulche (Lily Wear) [Color C]" (sold separately).

description.ja: ■特徴的なマントや武装も付属。
description.en: • Also includes a distinctive cloak and weapons.

description.ja: ■腕、脚に装着可能なリングタイプのジョイントパーツも多数付属し、キャラメイキングの幅が更に拡大！
description.en: • Many ring-type joint parts that can be attached to arms and legs are also included, further expanding the range of character creation!

accessories.ja: 無塗装フェイスパーツ×1
